FrontendProcessingPageTests.test_route_r.note: The path-based Files for Processing page (frontend/js/components/processing-files.js and frontend-app/src/features/processing/) belonged to the SQLite runtime and is deleted by PG-C2 (#641). The route no longer rescans an inbox; these pin that it mounts the queue page once the content is confirmed.

FrontendProcessingPageTests.test_legacy_.obsolete: The path-based Files for Processing page (frontend/js/components/processing-files.js and frontend-app/src/features/processing/) belonged to the SQLite runtime and is deleted by PG-C2 (#641). The module that owned the inbox preview iframe, its resize listener and the tag, folder and person quick-create helpers is gone, so there is no lifetime left to own. The PostgreSQL upload queue that replaced it is covered in frontend-app/src/features/processing-queue/ (queue.test.ts, session.test.ts, ProcessingQueueRoute.test.ts) and tests/e2e/test_postgres_library_flows.py::ProcessingQueueTests.
